observations: body L1-L5: the end of the addendum to p. xxxvi, n. 1, begun on p. XVI (Purbach's «Theo-ricis»). «Gherardi» is letter-spaced.

body L6-L37: the addenda hang from their references at the margin: the pages of the first volume, in small capitals for the roman numerals of its preface (L6, L8, L9, L12, L22, L26), with the arabic pages they also concern. «Suter», «Theonis», «al-Battānī», «Ahlwardt», «Barhebraei», «Ibn Ǵubayr», «Abū Nuwās», «Abū ’l-‘Alā’», «von Kremer» and «Ḥāǵǵī Khalīfah» are letter-spaced.
body L8: the i of «versionis» has a blob joined to its foot and looks like a j.

body L8-L11: the emendation of p. lxvi is italic; the parenthesis «(= » and «)» and the comma after it are roman. The hyphens of «18-21» and «26-27» are of the thinner sort (4.2 pt); the dash of «16–48» measures 5.0 pt and is set as a long dash. A grave mark over the o of «pro» and a tick after it, and a dot above the comma after «extr.)», are specks.

body L14: the Greek words are printed «ὀρθὴ σφκῖρα μεσουρκ́νησις πανταχῇ»: in σφαῖρα and μεσουράνησις a κ (in the open form of this type, as in «καὶ» on p. XV) stands for the α, and in the second word the acute of the ά stands on the κ. The misprints are transcribed as printed; the words are ὀρθὴ σφαῖρα μεσουράνησις πανταχῇ.
body L24: «يوم الشك» has a single kāf, its final form, without a shadda.
body L25: the second word of the title prints «’l-īlinās», with an l (the italic t of this type has a cross stroke); the Arabic word is الائتناس, al-i’tinās. The N of «Nuwās» prints broken.

body L28: the verse of the Luzūm, its two hemistichs side by side, the first on the right, each set at its printed centre: «ومرآة المنجّم وهي صُغْرَى» and «أَرَتْــهُ كلَّ عامرة وقَفْــرِ», with the vowels and the elongated joins as printed (the joins transcribed with tatweels). A fleck above the shadda of «المنجّم» (0.6 pt²) is a speck.

body L31-L32: the passage of the epistle, set right to left inside the Latin lines as printed: on L31 it begins at the right margin and ends with «شخصُها» next to «dicit:», on L32 it continues from «ضَئِـــلٌ», next to the Latin, to «والنجوم» at the left margin. «مَنابَ» and «شخصُها» carry their vowels; «ضَئِـــلٌ» is printed with fatḥa, the hamza on its seat with kasra below, a long join without the tooth and the dots of the yā’ of ḍa’īl, and the lām with the double ḍamma. The Arabic commas are printed as turned commas.
body L33: a tick before the first «mir’āh» is a speck.
body L37: «[ἀστήρ]» has the smooth breathing printed as a slanting stroke, as on p. XV.

notes_left L1-L9, notes_right L1-L8: six notes in two columns with a thin rule between them. «Ibn Ǵubayr», «Abu ’l-‘Alā» and «Margoliouth» (L9 and notes_right L2) are letter-spaced. The dash of note 2 measures 6.0 pt; the signs = are printed long (7.8 pt).
notes_right L6: «I e.» is printed without the stop after the I.
body: the signature «3*» stands at the foot of the page, at the right.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
